pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of scaling into positions when price action exhibits high-frequency oscillations or counter-trend momentum wicks; zero averaging down into falling knives.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Multi-timeframe volume profile and order book imbalance check must confirm directional momentum before order placement; absolute ban on entries within 15 minutes of major high-impact news releases.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively secure open profits as soon as trade hits the +$15.00 mark via trailing activation steps to prevent green runs from evaporating.
